openwrt_wiki.modelle: UniFi AP AC Pro, aka UAP-AC-PRO / UniFi AC Pro (techspecs.ui.com/unifi/wifi/uap-ac-pro)
openwrt_wiki.hinweis_gen1: Die ersten UAP-AC ("Gen1", quadratisches Gehäuse, Broadcom) werden nicht unterstützt
openwrt_wiki.hinweis_ports: For OpenWrt/LEDE on the Unifi AP AC Pro/Mesh Pro, LAN and WAN port assignment is "unexpected." LAN is on the port labeled "Secondary", whereas the port labeled "Main" is WAN.
openwrt_wiki.switch_pro: The UniFi AP AC PRO has a built-in switch and two external Ethernet ports. Port 2 on the switch corresponds to the primary Ethernet connector, Port 3 to the secondary. In their default configuration primary/secondary are assigned LAN/WAN interface.
openwrt_wiki.mesh_hinweis: As of OpenWrt 19.07 802.11s meshing is broken on Qualcomm AC Wave1 chipsets ... -ct firmware and kmod ... have to be removed and the normal upstream firmware and kmod must be installed
openwrt_wiki.installation: Non-invasive methods using dd / mtd per SSH on stock firmware ("works at least with the Unifi AC Pro with firmware 6.5.28 (February 2023)"); alternatively U-Boot with serial console; no factory images, sysupgrade only; ath79 recommended
openwrt_wiki.tftp_recovery: Reset button while powering up: after ~5 s blue LED, U-Boot erases cfg; holding additional 8 s starts TFTP server 192.168.1.20; OpenWrt cannot be flashed this way since the firmware must be signed, any official firmware works
openwrt_wiki.oem_firmware: Some firmwares are used for several models (UAP-AC-Lite, UAP-AC-LR, UAP-AC-Pro, UAP-AC-EDU, UAP-AC-M, UAP-AC-M-PRO, UAP-AC-IW, UAP-AC-IW-Pro, UAP-AC-UK-Ultra)
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse: The thinner front part can be separated with one's fingernails. At five equally distributed locations at the outer ring it snaps from the outside into the main back part. ... The platine is held with three easily reachable screws. (beschrieben ohne Modellangabe, Fotos darunter AC Lite)
openwrt_wiki.serial: The device has two pinheaders with serial ports. Both ports operate at 3.3V level, 115200 Baud, 8N1 and have the pinout +3,3V - RX - TX - GND. The port to the left (shown red) gives access to U-Boot and OpenWrt's console. (Foto AC Lite) Using the default/factory U-Boot environment there are no outputs from the kernel during booting; send a newline at 9600 Baud, then login at 115200

fcc_handbuch.Titel: UniFi AP-AC PRO Quick Start Guide, 802.11ac Dual-Radio Pro Access Point, Model: UAP-AC-PRO
fcc_handbuch.Package Contents: UniFi ac Pro, Mounting Bracket, Ceiling Backing Plate, Flat Head Screws (M3x50, Qty. 4), Keps Nuts (M3, Qty. 4), Screws (M2.9x20, Qty. 4), Screw Anchors (M3x20, Qty. 4), Gigabit PoE* (48V, 0.5A) with Mount Bracket, Power Cord*, Quick Start Guide; * Included only in the single-pack of the UAP-AC-PRO
fcc_handbuch.Outdoor Installation Requirements: The UAP-AC-PRO may be installed outdoors under an eave or other protected location. Do not install the UniFi AP in an open environment. Mounting location should be at least 60 cm (2 ft) from the edge of the eave or ceiling. Cable feed opening must be directed away from the open environment. Cable feed must be pointed downwards when wall-mounted. Shielded Category 5 (or above) cabling should be used for all outdoor wired Ethernet connections and should be grounded through the AC ground of the PoE.
fcc_handbuch.LED: White: Factory default, waiting to be integrated; Flashing White: Initializing; Alternating White/Blue: firmware upgrade; Blue: integrated and working; Quickly Flashing Blue: Locate; Steady Blue with occasional flashing: isolated state
fcc_handbuch.Ports: Security Slot, Secondary Port, Reset Button, Main Port (Reihenfolge der Zeichnung)
fcc_handbuch.Secondary: The Secondary port is a Gigabit Ethernet port used for bridging.
fcc_handbuch.Reset: Restart: Press and release quickly. Restore to Factory Default Settings: Press and hold for more than five seconds.
fcc_handbuch.Main: The Main port is a Gigabit Ethernet port used to connect the power and should be connected to the LAN and DHCP server.
fcc_handbuch.Abnehmen: insert a paper clip in the Security Slot to release the Locking Tab and turn the UniFi AP counterclockwise
fcc_handbuch.Wall Mount: 6 mm drill bit, optional 18 mm hole for cable feed; remove the rubber port cover; feed hole will stretch ... and then seal around the cable
fcc_handbuch.Ceiling Mount: ceiling tile, Ceiling Backing Plate, 3 mm drill bit, 18 mm hole

fcc_handbuch.Safety: Do not use this product in location that can be submerged by water.
